description: Watch-mode dev server start commands for the kala-ui workspace. All run from the repo root via pnpm workspace filters.

commands.name: Web Playground (Next dev)
commands.description: Next.js playground dev server (next dev, watch mode). Run 'pnpm build' once first if @kala-ui/react / @kala-ui/react-app dist output is missing.

commands.name: Native Playground (Expo / Metro)
commands.description: Expo dev server with Metro bundler in watch mode. Metro watches packages/react-native source directly, so library edits hot-reload without a rebuild. Press a for Android, i for iOS, w for web.

commands.name: Native Playground (Expo web)
commands.description: expo start --web — Metro watch mode serving the native playground in a browser.

commands.name: Storybook dev server
commands.description: Storybook for @kala-ui/react (storybook dev -p 6006) with story hot reload.

commands.name: react-hooks watch build
commands.description: tsdown --watch: rebuilds @kala-ui/react-hooks dist on change. Supporting watcher for surfaces that consume the built hooks package.
